pages.text: You walk upright, mostly. You climb better than you think. Your hands can hold things your mind does not yet understand.$(br2)That gap - between what the body can do and what the mind has thought of - is where your whole future lives.

There is a list at the edge of your vision. It is not a to-do list. It is a description of the animal you are becoming.$(br2)If it ever becomes too much, $(thing)/hominin checklist$() will quiet it. It will still be there when you look again.
With nothing to carry things in, you hold what your hands and arms can: your hotbar. Erectus carries another row; heidelbergensis and sapiens three. Only Neanderthals carry everything.
